payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear understanding of the problem of session segmentation in conversation systems, highlighting its importance and the proposed solutions.

claims.text: Session segmentation addresses the need to retain relevant context utterances while eliminating irrelevant ones in conversation systems.
Traditional document segmentation methods are not suitable for dialogue segmentation due to the unique characteristics of conversational data.
The proposed embedding-enhanced TextTiling approach improves segmentation by capturing semantics more effectively than traditional methods.
Efficient session segmentation is crucial for commercial chat-bots to meet performance demands and avoid processing irrelevant utterances.
